liveWire.latestSourceBlocker: Version 42 source is verified; the source for reported version 43 was unavailable for comparison.
liveWire.obsoleteDocumentation: The original README describes a superseded 97% model. Runnable source has the later independent-20%-reels model.

defaultModel.payoutAuthority: Accepted Live Wire local demo result; film presentation cannot change it.

cashfire.finiteMediaLimitation: Existing clips do not literally encode every Live Wire prize. Visible film action and the accepted award must be reconciled explicitly.
cashfire.mediaTransport: Byte-exact native files or compatible SHA-256-verified parts; no transcoding.

review.isolation: No playable wallet or result API imports; immutable fixed fixtures; separate iframe; guarded messages.
review.verification: See build test and coverage evidence; implementation alone is not a passed check.

description: A four-reel demo preserving the Live Wire outcome model and controls with Cashfire artwork and native shooting-spree bonus presentation.
productRequirements: Preserve four independent 20% reels and established normal/Mega prize distributions.
Show bonus maxima in the player interface; conditional means remain technical model data.
Use anticipation after two confirmed boxes and stronger anticipation after three with one reel remaining.
Keep the accepted monetary award independent of video playback, kills, pause, skip and recovery.
Keep this game in a separate repository with its original base controls and flow.
